body: Shipped profile follow-up: removed custom top material and restored NavigationStack-owned top scroll edge; tightened hero bottom blur to final third while increasing radius 34→52; group/channel Edit and Channel settings now render inline with callback-driven Cancel/Done instead of path pushes, while deeper detail pages still use NavigationStack. Generic unsigned iOS build is green; attached phone was offline and CoreSimulatorService unavailable.
author: Vibe Team
